findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: manifest_audit · Private data: package_advisories, vuln_details · Public sink: package_advisories, manifest_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: manifest_audit · Private data: package_advisories, vuln_details · Public sink: package_advisories, manifest_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
